purpose: Material and finish specification board for elderly AI companion device
prompt:
Professional industrial design material and finish specification board for an elderly AI companion device called "Bàn".

Layout: Material board on warm cream background (#F5F0E8). Show 4 large material sample swatches arranged in a 2x2 grid, each approximately 300x250px with rounded corners. Each sample shows a realistic close-up texture photograph with a label below.

Material samples:
1. Top-left: "Acoustic-Transparent Fabric" — Fine linen weave texture in warm cream #F5F0E8, soft and tactile, like a premium cushion cover. Show the weave pattern clearly. Label: "surface-cream | Removable, washable | Acoustic transparent"

2. Top-right: "Light Oak Wood" — Natural light oak wood grain in warm honey tone #C4A882, open-pore finish showing wood texture, not high-gloss. Label: "accent-wood | Open-pore finish | Natural grain"

3. Bottom-left: "Soft-Touch Matte Plastic" — Smooth matte surface in warm gray #D4CFC7 with fine sand-blast texture (120-180 grit), no fingerprints, warm to touch. Label: "surface-warm-gray | 120-180 grit matte | Anti-fingerprint"

4. Bottom-right: "LED Light Diffuser" — Translucent fabric/resine material showing warm amber glow #E8B87A diffusing through it, soft radial gradient, no visible LED dots. Label: "glow-amber zone | Frosted diffuser | 2700K warm white"

Below the grid: a thin strip showing the material junction detail — how fabric meets wood base, with a small cross-section diagram.

Bottom annotation: "All materials warm-toned, tactile, non-clinical. No stainless steel, no glass, no cold surfaces."

Style: professional CMF specification board, material-science aesthetic, warm lighting, editorial layout. Humanist sans-serif labels. Generous spacing. No decorative graphics.
